items.title: Belief all that’s left for Tigers
items.summary: Instead of stamping their authority on the game, Bangladesh's batters were left in despair at the end of Day 3 of the first Test against West Indies at the Sher-e-Bangla National Cricket Stadium yesterday.

items.title: Nayeem steps out of shadows

items.title: Mission 200: Nayeem hopes to turn the tide
items.summary: Day three is traditionally the moving day of a Test match, and things certainly moved swiftly in the first Test between Bangladesh and West Indies in Mirpur on Friday. Unfortunately for the hosts, the movement was entirely in the wrong direction.
